title: Origenes Adamantius: Tractatus super Leviticum
shelf_note: Origen's Homilies on Leviticus in Rufinus' Latin (p136 rubric 'Explicit lib. xi. Incip. xii. De magno sacerdote' matches Homily XII on the high priest). No tradition or collection given; patristic allegorical exegesis is adjacent to the library's early-Christian/Hermetic scope.
structure_note: No structure counts in the packet. None of the three pages has a translation: the `translation` field is empty on all three. Foliation is consistent: image 47 is foliated '22' (recto). The 'published 1300' date may be too late for this hand, which looks 12th-century protogothic to me (low confidence). The images carry the Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel scale bar.

book_verdict: This is the right work on the right leaves, but no page has a translation, and the OCR is unreliable: on p47 a 'non tamen' is read as 'etiam', reversing the sense, and a whole line is dropped. On p136 a 30-line marginal table of contents is invented and the homily numbers are misread (XI/XII as VI/VII). An expert would distrust the transcription on sight.
